title: Rule Book screen text is missing from index.html

where.function: Rule Book menu tile / expected #ruleBook markup

steps: Open the main menu, where the RULE BOOK tile is present.
Follow the Rule Book route: screens.js treats ruleBook as a valid screen name.
Check index.html for the corresponding #ruleBook section and rules text.
expected: index.html contains a #ruleBook screen whose rule text can be read and checked against the scoring and competition code.
actual: index.html contains the RULE BOOK menu tile but no #ruleBook section or Rule Book text. screens.js still expects document.getElementById('ruleBook') to exist before it can show that screen.
root_cause: The static Rule Book section was omitted from index.html while ruleBook remains registered as a routable screen.
checked_against: index.html:347-349 visible season scoring hint says Champions League +5, league title +3, domestic cup +1, one shared +1 performance bonus, one shared +1 awards bonus, maximum 11.
js/scoring.js:1-35 implements those same scoring values and shared bonus rules.
js/screens.js:1-15 registers ruleBook and showScreen requires a matching DOM element.

fix.change: Restore a #ruleBook screen in index.html with the complete current rules, or make the rule screen's dynamic creation explicit and guaranteed before navigation. Keep its scoring text aligned with SCORING_RULES and winner/tiebreak behavior.

assumptions: This chat check is limited to four code files. A separate optional module could inject #ruleBook at runtime; that module was not read in this pass.
Because no node reproduction was run in Chat mode, status is likely rather than confirmed.
